title: High-throughput isoform-wide miRNome sequence reconstruction in the TCGA-LUAD cohort
author: Marvin De los Santos
materials: Preprocess and normalize the genomic coordinate annotations.

steps.title: Download TCGA‑LUAD miRSeq data
steps.instruction: Visit https://gdac.broadinstitute.org/, agree to the TCGA data‑use guidelines, select the Lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) cohort, open the LUAD Archive pop‑up, navigate to the miRSeq section, choose the file named “illuminahiseq_mirnaseq‑miR_isoform_expression”, and download the tab‑delimited .txt file.

steps.title: Prepare annotation file
steps.instruction: Open the downloaded .txt file in a spreadsheet program, filter out rows with missing or incorrectly formatted values, ensure the “isoform_coords” column follows the required format assembly:chromosome:start‑end:strand (e.g., hg19:9:106938220‑106938244:+), and rename the column headers: “SampleId” → “sample_id”, “miRNA_ID” → “gene_id”, “isoform_coords” → “seq_loc”, “read_count” → “description”.

substeps.instruction: Open the .txt file in a spreadsheet program.
Remove rows containing missing or malformed values.
Rename columns to the required names.

steps.title: Install required software
steps.instruction: Install Python dependencies with pip install pandas pyfaidx tqdm and install samtools via apt‑get update -qq && apt‑get install -y samtools.

steps.title: Obtain FAS2rDNA CLI
steps.instruction: Download the FAS2rDNA‑CLI script from https://fas2rdna.chordexbio.com/ or clone the GitHub repository at https://github.com/mahvin92/FAS2rDNA.

steps.title: Run FAS2rDNA reconstruction
steps.instruction:
Execute the CLI, pointing to the directory that contains the prepared annotation file. Example commands:
python3 fas2rdna.py \
  --input-dir /Users/Desktop/FAS2rDNA
or, to embed a custom FASTA header:
python3 fas2rdna.py \
  --input-dir /Users/Desktop/FAS2rDNA \
  --header "{sample_id}|{gene_id}|{seq_loc}|{description}"

steps.title: Inspect generated FASTA files
steps.instruction:
After the run finishes, examine the output tree under /Users/Desktop/FAS2rDNA/, which contains:
/Users/Desktop/FAS2rDNA/
├── LUAD.txt
├── test.txt
└── fas2rdna_output/
    ├── genomes/
    └── fasta/
        ├── LUAD.fasta
        ├── test.fasta
        └── All_sequences.fasta

steps.title: Validate FASTA output
steps.instruction:
Cross‑reference the FASTA sequences with the original annotation to confirm that every sample is represented, that each entry is in proper FASTA format, and that the files are not empty.
Sample input rows (excerpt):
sample_id gene_id seq_loc description
